rv.q: In My Own Litle World succeeds both in presenting a captivating, tightly-paced 70 minutes of theatre, and in creating a space which truly feels safe and inclusive.
Overall, In My Own Little World is a production to be proud of. Heartfelt, funny, emotional and extremely candid – it's definitely a rollercoaster, and one worth getting on.
Simply put, IN MY OWN LITTLE WORLD is a triumph.

cn.t: Critics largely rave over Jaz Terry's solo show, praising her magnetic stage presence and the raw, authentic storytelling of a trans woman's journey. One voice finds it slightly uneven, but the consensus is clear: bold, vital theatre.
